vedic_reference.note: Mythili is the name of a character in the Mahabharata. She is a wife of Bhishma Pitamaha. She was cursed by Shakuni, and as a result, she was born as a demoness with a thousand eyes. She was later killed by Bhima during the Mahabharata war.
